light.name: Light
light.text: Each piece: stamina returns 2% faster, swings cost 1% less.

heavy.name: Heavy
heavy.text: Each piece: stamina returns 2% slower, swings cost 1% more, guarding costs 1.2% less.

crownless.name: Crownless
crownless.why: The knight's own plate and the garrison's: soldiers of a throne with nobody on it.

widow.name: Widow
widow.why: The black lacquered suit: the lightest and darkest of the eight, the one a mourner would wear to a duel.

gravekeeper.name: Gravekeeper
gravekeeper.why: The vigil plate of those who stood watch over the dead; the Gravewarden still carries half of it.

frostwarden.name: Frostwarden
frostwarden.why: Rimebound plate of the Frozen Citadel.

dragonforged.name: Dragonforged
dragonforged.why: Broodscale harness from the Wyrm's Roost.

architect.name: Architect
architect.why: The hollowed suit from the Deep: the oldest work, made by whoever built the guardians.

m_iron.name: Old Iron
m_iron.desc: Garrison stock, sound under the rust.

m_silver.name: Grave Silver
m_silver.desc: Poured for the dead. It takes an edge the living never asked of it.

m_rime.name: Rimesteel
m_rime.desc: Steel that wintered in the Citadel and did not come back the same.

m_glass.name: Hollow Glass
m_glass.desc: Not glass. Orren will not say what it was part of.

m_core.name: Guardian Core
m_core.desc: What a guardian was built around. One to a guardian.

blade.name: Blade
blade.text: Reforge: +10% damage and +8% guard damage a tier.

grip.name: Grip
grip.text: Rewrap and rebalance: swings 3% quicker and 5% cheaper a tier.

ore.name: Ore
ore.text: The metal itself: +3% damage a tier, and it sets how far blade and grip can be taken.

m_scale.name: Wyrm Scale
m_scale.text: Burns: a fire edge, if the blade has no element

m_rime.name: Rimesteel
m_rime.text: Bites: a frost edge, if the blade has no element

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.text: A keen edge: +8% damage for the next three fights, win or lose. It cannot be stacked.

shield_rules.text: A shield stops so many blows, then it is spent until you give it a few seconds. A block timed to the blow costs it nothing.

Oathbreaker.note: was an axe; now a greatsword as the brief asks. The id is kept.

challenges.name: Both Hands
challenges.text: Master two sets of twin blades.
